description: Daily trading data of one Taiwan stock or ETF, newest day first (since 2021): price (open, high, low, close, change, volume, turnover; raw prices not adjusted for dividends, null on days without a trade), institutional (net buying by the three institutional investor types: foreign_* is foreign and mainland Chinese investors excluding foreign-owned dealers, trust_* investment trusts, dealer_* dealers' proprietary trading and hedging, total_net all three), margin (margin purchases and short sales with balances and limits), securities_lending (short sales of borrowed securities) and foreign_holding (shares issued, foreign holding and its percent, room left and the legal limit). All counts are shares (the exchanges publish margin data in lots; converted). Taiwan daily prices are government open data. Quotes and institutional data arrive at about 5:30 PM Taiwan time; margin, securities lending and foreign holding data at about 10:30 PM, so on the latest day those parts can be null (note says so). change_pct is calculated by Livermore. tw_list_institutional_ranking ranks the whole market. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

code.description: Taiwan stock code, e.g. 2330 (TSMC), 0050 (an ETF) or 00981A. Lowercase, 2330.TW and 2330.TWO also work. Use tw_search to find a code by company name.

days.description: Number of trading days, newest first (1-200, default 20). Data starts in 2021.

name: tw_get_daily_trading

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

name_en.description: English short name (for example TSMC); null when there is none.

foreign_limit_pct.description: The legal limit on foreign holding (%).

remaining_shares.description: Shares foreign investors may still buy.

foreign_holding.description: Foreign and mainland Chinese investors' holding.

foreign_net.description: Foreign and mainland Chinese investors, excluding foreign dealers.

institutional.description: Institutional investors' buying and selling (shares); net is buy minus sell.

note.description: Exchange note codes as published, e.g. X short sales suspended, O margin purchases suspended.

offset_shares.description: Day-trade offsets between margin purchases and short sales.

short_redeem.description: Short positions closed by delivering shares.

change.description: As published; null when not comparable (e.g. ex-dividend day).

change_pct.description: change divided by the previous close (%), calculated by Livermore.

close.description: null when the stock did not trade that day.

next_day_limit.description: Shares that may be sold this way on the next trading day.

sell.description: Shares sold short with borrowed securities that day.

securities_lending.description: Short sales of borrowed securities (SBL), in shares.

url.description: The chips page on tw.livermore.club (Traditional Chinese).

title: Taiwan stock: daily prices and chips
